title: Progressive-reveal hero + collapsible step cards with automated screenshot pipeline
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Replace the static hero on the Quickstart landing with a progressive-reveal hero that surfaces 3 staged onboarding moments (Start, Integrate, Launch) and pairs with collapsible step cards below. Deliverables: 1) Figma hero artboard with motion specs (Lottie + CSS fallback), 2) responsive step card system (expanded/collapsed states + microcopy), 3) color/token variants for light/dark and high-contrast, 4) screenshot generation pipeline for release docs and embeds (Chromium headless + storybook snapshots), 5) final export pack for engineering and marketing (SVGs, Lottie JSON, optimized PNGs). This ticket covers design exploration, final artboards, handoff package, and verification screenshots. Decisions to make: choose between vector Lottie motion vs CSS keyframe animations for smaller payloads; determine microinteraction timing to avoid impacting perceived TTI; finalize collapsed card content density to hit WCAG target reading size on mobile. Dependencies: engineering hook for ephemeral feature flag to enable progressive reveal in staging for screenshot capture and QA.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with annotated hero frames and motion spec exported and linked
Responsive step card component documented with collapsed/expanded states and copy for each step
Accessible color token set with contrast checks for all variants (report attached)
Automated screenshot pipeline that produces consistent PNGs for docs and release pages from storybook stories
Engineering sign-off on handoff package and a validated staging build with feature flag enabled
